visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with messy black hair, wearing a gray sleeveless hoodie and red hand wraps, stands in a simulated boxing ring with bright stadium lights. He performs high-energy boxing jabs and hooks toward the camera. Stylized yellow and orange flame-like graphic overlays flare up around his arms to emphasize the speed and power of his movements. (2) The scene cuts to a real UFC Gym interior with rows of heavy punching bags. The man, now in a white t-shirt and black shorts, delivers powerful kicks to a large black heavy bag labeled TAIWAN and UFC GYM. The background shows industrial gym lighting and other training equipment hanging from the dark ceiling structure. (3) The man is now in a modern office, sitting in a gray mesh office chair with his bare leg resting on a wooden desk. He looks weary, resting his face in his hand. A female coworker in a green shirt sits behind him, focused on her laptop. A professional microphone on a boom arm is visible. (4) Transition to a minimalist product showcase. A white and gray SIDIZ T50 AIR office chair is centered against a pitch-black background. Shimmering light trails and glowing digital diagrams highlight the chair's S-curve backrest and breathable mesh seat. The lighting is dramatic, accentuating the sleek industrial design and materials. (5) Detailed close-up shots show hands interacting with the chair's adjustment levers and lumbar support. The man is shown sitting in the chair, demonstrating the synchronized tilting mechanism while holding a prayer-like hand gesture. The setting is a clean, neutral-toned room with simple wall panels and bright, even lighting. (6) A montage shows rows of these office chairs in a large, bright corporate office setting, suggesting widespread professional adoption. The man then returns to the frame, standing and boxing with his red wraps while the chair is behind him, ending with a screen of promotional text for the Double 11 shopping event.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo electronic beat featuring synthesized pulses and rapid percussion. Sharp, airy whoosh sound effects with high spectral brightness occur in quick succession, mimicking the sound of fast physical swings. The narrator's voice enters with a calm, low-pitched, and professional tone, articulating clearly with moderate breathiness. (2) A series of low-frequency, muffled thudding sounds with short decay times punctuate the mix, signifying heavy physical impacts. The background music maintains its energetic BPM but lowers in volume to allow these percussive foley effects to dominate the acoustic space. No other environmental noise is audible in this studio-clean recording. (3) The narrator's voice transitions to a casual, conversational style with higher pitch variability and frequent pauses. The background music remains as a subtle, rhythmic bed. There is a very faint room tone consistent with an indoor office, but it remains below the primary signal, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) The audio design becomes hyper-active with the addition of several digital UI sound effects, including high-pitched dings, soft metallic clicks, and electronic chirps signifying technological features. The narrator's tone shifts to an excited, high-arousal promotional delivery with faster speech rate and emphasized pitch contours to highlight brand names. (5) A short, sharp female vocalization with high pitch and sudden onset creates a brief acoustic contrast. The narrator concludes with an authoritative and confident command. The background music swells in volume for a final crescendo, featuring rich harmonic textures and a strong, driving beat before a hard cut to silence at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook (Muay Thai Training) -> Pivot (Office Discomfort) -> Solution (Ergonomic Support) -> Feature Breakdown -> Promotional Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the SIDIZ T50 AIR ergonomic office chair by humorously comparing the core strength and physical balance required in Muay Thai to the essential spinal support needed for long hours of office work.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct on-camera product demonstration, clear brand logo displays, and specific promotional details for the Double 11 shopping event.
